title: Invitations
lead: Email candidates a link to take their AI interview, written the way your company speaks.

library.startersLead: Written by LetsHyre. Make a copy to change the wording.
library.subject: Subject:
library.emptyTitle: No templates of your own yet
library.emptyBody: Copy a starter template, then change the wording and sign-off to sound like your team.
library.errorBody: Nothing has been sent or changed. Check your connection and try again.

copy.title: Make a copy
copy.lead: Your copy starts with the wording of “{{name}}”. Only your company sees it.
copy.name: Template name
copy.nameError: Give it a name of up to {{max}} characters.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.body: The template is removed for everyone on your team. Invitations already sent aren't affected. This can't be undone.

toast.copyFailed: The copy wasn't made. Try again.
toast.deleteFailed: The template wasn't deleted. Try again.
toast.saveFailed: Your changes weren't saved. Try again.

editor.lead: Changes apply to invitations you send after saving.
editor.name: Template name
editor.subject: Subject
editor.subjectPlaceholder: What candidates see in their inbox
editor.bodyPlaceholder: Write your invitation. Type {{ to add a field like the candidate's name.
editor.bodyHint: Fields are filled in for each candidate when the email is sent.
editor.readOnlyBody: Make a copy and it becomes yours to reword, rename and send.
editor.fidelityTitle: Some formatting can't be edited here
editor.fidelityBody: This template uses layout the editor doesn't support, so the message is locked to keep it intact. You can still change the name and subject. Converting keeps the words but simplifies that layout.
editor.missingBody: It may have been deleted by someone on your team.

errors.name: Give it a name of up to 120 characters.
errors.subject: Write a subject of up to 200 characters.
errors.body: Write the message candidates will read.
errors.inviteLink: Add the invite link so candidates can start their interview.
errors.unknown: Remove fields LetsHyre doesn't fill in; they're shown in red.

toolbar.label: Formatting
toolbar.fields: Fields filled in for each candidate

link.lead: Choose where the link takes the candidate.
link.inviteHint: Each candidate gets their own link to sign up and start the interview.
link.urlError: Enter a full address that starts with https://

button.lead: A button stands out more than a link. Use one for the main action.
button.label: Button text
button.labelError: Write the text on the button.

ready.title: Ready to send
ready.subject: Has a subject line
ready.name: Greets the candidate by name
ready.known: Uses only fields LetsHyre fills in

draft.title: You have unsaved changes from earlier
draft.body: They were kept on this device when you left the page. Restore them to keep editing, or discard them.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: Your changes to this template will be lost.
